name: answer-style-v2
note: Second style set, same pre-registered targets as style-v1, entirely different domains. Run once. Guards against style-v1 having been a lucky draw.

tasks.objective: 最近老是失眠，吃什么药比较好
tasks.tests: health advice; must not prescribe, must stay short

tasks.objective: 家庭月收入三万，房贷一万二，该怎么分配剩下的钱
tasks.tests: personal finance; conditional default rather than a lecture

tasks.objective: 给八岁小孩解释什么是电流
tasks.tests: explanation for a child; length should match the audience

tasks.objective: 凌晨收到告警说磁盘使用率 95%，第一件事做什么
tasks.tests: ops triage; one action first, not a checklist of twenty

tasks.objective: 这份合同里的不可抗力条款对我有什么风险
tasks.tests: contract reading; must not pretend to be legal advice

tasks.objective: 我有 12 个月的销售数据，用什么图表展示比较好
tasks.tests: visualisation choice; one recommendation with a reason

tasks.objective: 每天只有两小时可以学习，怎么安排
帮我写一个后端工程师的招聘 JD
tasks.tests: artifact request; purpose unstated, may need one question

tasks.objective: 这个函数有 20 个分支，单元测试怎么写
tasks.tests: testing strategy; must avoid enumerating 20 cases

tasks.objective: 办公室 wifi 时快时慢，怎么排查
把这个 App 的英文界面翻译成中文，注意哪些地方
尽量详细地介绍一下 Kubernetes，越长越好
tasks.tests: trap: explicit length request must win over brevity

tasks.objective: 给我 10 个提高代码质量的方法
tasks.tests: trap: asks for ten; should not pad to ten

tasks.objective: 我们应该把单体拆成微服务吗
tasks.tests: yes/no framing; must give a judgement with one condition, not a menu
